edges.notes: dietlibc implements a minimal C standard library for Linux userland.
dietlibc provides syscall wrappers and POSIX-oriented services on Linux.
dietlibc is used with ELF objects and static/dynamic linking on Linux.
The dietlibc toolchain integrates with GCC via the documented diet driver/wrapper.
GNU ld/as participate in dietlibc link flows on Linux.
Clang may be used in custom embedded flows; dietlibc is primarily documented around GCC integration.
Architecture coverage depends on upstream ports; treat per-target as environment-specific.
g++ may link GNU libstdc++ above dietlibc only in specialized minimal Linux toolchains when configured.
Clang libc++ above dietlibc is uncommon but possible in custom sysroots.
libc++abi pairs with libc++ in the same uncommon minimal Clang+dietlibc stacks.
